source.title: Dapagliflozin and Kidney Outcomes in Patients With Heart Failure With Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction: A Prespecified Analysis of the DELIVER Randomized Clinical Trial

entries.claim: Baseline kidney function did not materially modify the primary cardiovascular treatment effect.
Dapagliflozin caused an acute eGFR dip and then slowed chronic eGFR decline.
The post hoc kidney composite was infrequent and not significantly reduced.
Safety events were mostly balanced across randomized groups within baseline eGFR strata.
Kidney interpretation is limited by low event counts, lack of albuminuria, and exclusion of eGFR below 25.
Funding and author interpretation are provenance/appraisal context rather than outcome data.
